package def

//roost:dao coll=alliances db=game dbscope=global
type AllianceDao struct {
	Name     string            `bson:"name" remoteview:"public,member"`
	Level    int32             `bson:"level" remoteview:"public,member"`
	Bonus    int64             `bson:"bonus" remoteview:"member"`
	Treasury int64             `bson:"treasury"`
	Tags     []string          `bson:"tags" remoteview:"public"`
	Members  map[int64]*Member `bson:"members" remoteview:"member"`
	Profile  *Member           `bson:"profile" remoteview:"member"`
	Blobs    map[string][]byte `bson:"blobs" remoteview:"member"`
}
type Member struct {
	Name      string           `bson:"name"`
	Scores    []int64          `bson:"scores"`
	Buffs     map[string]int64 `bson:"buffs"`
	Transient string           `bson:"transient" dao:"nopersist,nosync"`
}
